item.title: feat(plugin-sdk): export saveMediaSource from media-store (#125278)
item.summary: feat(plugin-sdk): export saveMediaSource from media-store (#125278) Plugins holding a remote URL had no non-deprecated Plugin SDK path to turn it into managed media; saveMediaSource was only reachable through the deprecated media-runtime barrel while docs pointed at media-store. Re-export it from the focused subpath and move the bundled qa-channel plugin off the deprecated barrel. Maintainer decision: full saveMediaSource (local path + HTTP(S)) is the supported media-store contract. Fixes #125259
